01 / PREPARATION

Before you start

Check your exact Apple device, iOS or macOS version, available storage, and the release notes for the build you are researching. Compatibility information on this site is guidance, not a guarantee that every device or configuration will work.

  • Confirm your exact device model on the Compatibility page.
  • Keep enough local storage for your own game data and backups.
  • Back up saves before changing an existing setup.
  • Read the release notes before making changes to a working installation.
02 / RELEASES

Review the release information first

The public website documents changes, known issues, supported platforms, and community-reported behavior. It does not ask you to install software from pop-ups, browser warnings, or system-style prompts.

Verify what you are opening

Use the release name, date, and community announcement to confirm that information matches what you intended to access. If something unexpected asks for a password, certificate, authentication code, or payment, stop and verify the source.

Read release notes
03 / GAME DATA

Use your own legitimate game files

The project expects users to provide their own lawfully obtained GTA V game data. The website does not host or distribute Rockstar game assets. Keep a separate backup before moving, replacing, or reorganizing files.

Build-specific file layout can change. Use the release notes and community discussion to identify the expected format without sharing private account information.

04 / MEMORY

Memory guidance

The Compatibility page uses conservative planning guidance for RAM and storage. Installed RAM is not the same as memory available to an app, and no website setting can increase physical RAM.

Third-party memory or signing utilities are independent projects. This community does not operate them. Review their own documentation and security practices before using them.

05 / MAINTENANCE

Updates and backups

Read the relevant release notes before changing a working build. Keep copies of saves and other personal data you care about. Do not assume that replacing or removing an app will preserve local data.

06 / SUPPORT

Safe support practices

  • Share device model, OS version, build name, error text, and non-sensitive logs when needed.
  • Do not post passwords, Apple Account credentials, Rockstar credentials, authentication tokens, recovery codes, signing certificates, or private keys.
  • Do not install software because a browser message claims your device is infected or outdated.
  • Verify community staff identities before sharing files or following account-related instructions.
